default.description: Default capabilities for Glyph. The dialog, fs, and store plugins get the exact commands the frontend calls, never their default sets, which resolve renderer-supplied paths (see docs/security/threat-model.md).

desktop.description: Desktop-only capabilities for Glyph (plugins that don't exist on mobile)

mobile.description: Mobile-only capabilities for Glyph. Android and iOS pickers hand back sandboxed content:// URIs that the Rust fs commands cannot open, so the OS document picker (dialog open) and the fs plugin read those instead (src/lib/pickers.ts, src/lib/documentContent.ts). Desktop is deliberately excluded: there the Rust pickers and the grant registry are the only filesystem gate.
